tests.prompt:
Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "Active"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

What size do you want? (Default / Small) Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 6. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "Active".

Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "AuditField42"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

What size do you want? (Default / Small) Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 5. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "AuditField42".

Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "Active"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

What size do you want? (Default / Small) Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 5. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "Active".

Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "Active"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

Size: Small - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 5. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "Active".

Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "Active"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

What size do you want? (Default / Small) Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 5. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "Active".

OVERVIEW

Badge draws attention to a count, a new item, or a status without interrupting the flow - a small dot, number, or short status label typically overlaid on or placed beside another element, like a notification bell or an avatar.

WHEN TO USE

An unread notification count - a number badge on a bell or inbox icon.
A new-feature indicator dot - flagging something recently added.
An account status label or a cart item count - a compact signal attached to another element.

WHEN NOT TO USE

Standalone status text with no attached element - use Tag instead - Badge is meant to overlay or sit beside something else, not stand alone.
A count so large or so central to the task that it deserves its own visible number in the main content - don't shrink primary information into a small corner badge.
A persistent label describing a whole row or card's category - use Tag, which is built for that role.

BEST PRACTICES

Cap large counts with a "99+" style ceiling rather than letting the badge grow to fit an arbitrarily large number.
Reserve badge colors consistently (e.g. red for alerts, neutral for plain counts) across the product.
Remove or hide the badge entirely at zero/none, rather than showing an empty "0".

DO AND DON'T

DON'T

A sentence-length label defeats what a badge is for - a glance, not a read. Keep the label to a word or two, or drop it for the dot alone.

ACCESSIBILITY

The count or status is exposed to assistive technology as text, not conveyed by a colored dot alone.
When overlaid on an icon button, the badge's information is included in that button's accessible name ("Notifications, 3 unread").
Sufficient contrast between the badge and whatever it's layered on top of.

Create a complete Badge component for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (form, color, size) - a small indicator, not a one-off number or dot hard-coded per screen.

Badge is not interactive - unlike most components in this system, it has no hover, focus or disabled state. Its variation is purely structural: 3 forms, each in 4 semantic colors, each in 2 sizes.

Forms (3):
- Count: a small numeric pill overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element (an icon or button). Shows the current Count value, capping the display at "99+" once Count exceeds the configured Max count.
- Dot: a small plain dot overlaid on the top-right corner of a host element, with no number - just signals "there's something new".
- Status: an inline dot plus a text label (e.g. "Active"), used standalone rather than overlaid on anything.

Colors (5, apply to every form, matching Ant Design's own Status Badge set): Default (var(--red-500), this system's brand red), Success (var(--green-500)), Processing (var(--blue-500), pulses with an expanding-ring animation to signal something actively in progress), Warning (var(--amber-500)), Error (var(--danger-500)).

What size do you want? (Default / Small) Small drops the Count pill to 16px/10px font and the Status dot+label to match - the host icon and every color stay identical at either size.

Component properties: Count (number, applies only to the Count type) - currently 5. Max count (number, applies only to the Count type, caps the displayed value at "N+" once Count exceeds it) - currently 99. Status label (string, applies only to the Status type) - currently "Active".
